title: Generate spring networks
action: Generate two-dimensional unstressed harmonic spring networks with N=62500 nodes (250x250 lattice) and target coordination excess δz values of 0.05, 0.2, and 0.8. Follow the protocol of Wyart et al. (2008): start from a highly coordinated lattice and remove bonds randomly while preserving rigidity and zero stress. Record node positions, bond connectivities, and rest lengths.
description: Generated network configurations required for subsequent computation.

title: Compute displacement response to bond dipoles
action: For each generated network, construct the dynamical matrix M and the geometric operator S. For each bond α, solve the linear system M δR^(α) = S^T |α⟩ to obtain the displacement field induced by a unit dipolar force, using an iterative solver (e.g., conjugate gradient) with appropriate tolerance.

title: Compute bond response function C(r)
action: From the displacement fields, compute the bond-bond matrix elements and average the squared values over all bond pairs separated by distance r, binning to obtain C(r) for each δz. Save the results.
description: Bond response function C(r) for each coordination excess δz.

title: Extract lengthscale ℓ_c
action: For each δz, compute r^4 * C(r) from the response function, locate the peak position r_max, and record it as ℓ_c. Save the results.
description: Extracted lengthscale ℓ_c for each δz.
